title: Light Wood Spinning Mouthpiece
description:
DynaVaps Light Wood Spinning Mouthpiece is hand crafted out of beautiful hardwood and provides a more even temperature gradient when heating your vapcap.
The Light Wood Spinning Mouthpiece can be used on both the standard and XL sized vapcaps.
If you are unsure about compatibility please feel free to get in touch. We are more then happy to help.
Included
1 x Light Wood Spinning mouthpiece
